tasks.body:
The line claimed the fold 'drops whatever I can't trace', but with soft grounding
(fold-chat-pivot.js SOFT_WHY, strict off) a sentence whose only failure is that the
pages don't back its wording is SPOKEN and counted unsourced (the record draws the
mark). The witness test (fold-chat-self.witness.test.mjs) had flagged the overclaim
as a todo; the line is corrected, the claim is split in two (hard failures withheld,
soft ones marked), each half has its witness, and the todo is now a plain test.

tasks.body:
A wandered sentence is grounded at its byte (Tarski convention-T): classifyEssay
now accepts a witnesses map and marks a VERBATIM source sentence grounded even
where claim-matching cannot re-bind it out of context — and a verbatim negation

tasks.body:

tasks.subject: seam screen: a being must be a name, or fold a wide company, or participate — scene-words refused
tasks.body:
the teller's last gap: words whose surface sits in the text ('Legs', 'Morning',
'Face') but are miseated common nouns. screenBeings multiplies three mechanical
signals, none decisive alone (case-free law: the capital is only corroborating):
  - NAME: recurs capitalized mid-sentence (proper beings use name-form in prose)
  - FOLD: company >= 8 (the protagonists)
  - PARTICIPATE: is a patient somewhere and keeps company >= 3
On attested edges this cuts 343->141 edges, 57->17 telling sentences, keeps
source-says at 100%, and the subject roster becomes proper names (anna, prince,
pierre, andrew, n

tasks.subject: telling: literary present, ATTESTED ONLY — the material decides presence
tasks.body:
my first inflector generated forms ('kisses', 'enters') — a regression against
the competency earned chasing Telemachus onto the boat: inflection is HOW A
READER HEARS, never how it invents (morphology.js actClosure, wall 2: only
forms ATTESTED IN THIS MATERIAL join; the prior decides sameness, the material
decides presence). The teller now adopts the present-3sg candidate ONLY when
the source token stream contains it; otherwise the seam-bound base form (itself
attested) stands. 'says'/'writes'/'spends' appear because the book has them;
'ran'/'cough' keep base because their presents are absent

tasks.subject: seam screen: postures of address are never beings; the screen now gates the telling path
tasks.body:
'I'll get anna.' — a first-person posture seated as a being, breaking the
third-person doctrine ('who the text does things to and by'). isBeing now
carries the received posture closed class (i/you/he/she… + contractions,
giver lang/en); 'i'll'/'you'/'her' are refused at the box.

Also: screenBeings now gates summarize.mjs and mechanical-telling.mjs (the
actual telling path, not just the experiment) — 1053 -> 743 -> ~141 edges,
'Morning'/'Exception'/'Eyes' gone, the roster is named people (anna, prince,
petersburg, empress, funke, hippolyte, mortemart, vicomte), attestation stays
100%, 0 model

tasks.subject: telling: a teller-subject must be attested as an actor — name, or >4 acts
tasks.body:
the last actor-nonsense: pos-prior-en knows 'step'/'sort'/'round' are NOUNS and

tasks.subject: telling: a told patient must be attested — name, or a patient >=3 times
tasks.body:
the object mirror of tellerSubjects: 'educate bear', 'indulged sort', 'seized
pierre's' — a noun the POS prior knows, seated once as the object — is refused
as a TOLD patient. patVol >= 3 (a patient the material repeatedly takes) or a
name opens the slot; else the act is not told on that thing. The worst
object-miseats leave the telling ('Anna greeted prince, and kissed prince').
Record keeps every edge; the telling refuses the slot. opt-in (no name set in
view => legacy). 41/41.

tasks.subject: telling: gated full-name resolution — resolve the bearer at its own act, else keep the title
tasks.body:
'prince' is a MERGED identity: Prince Vasíli Kurágin x207 and Prince Andrew
Bolkónski x1143 both recur. Resolving to 'his full name' first needs WHICH
bearer, per act, by company: titleRuns harvest the verbatim capitalized
multi-word surfaces; fullName counts a bearer's family name in the window
AROUND the act (floor 2, majority 2x); a mixed window (a reception with
several Princes) REFUSES and the ambiguous-but-true title stands. So the
telling now renders 'Anna Pávlovna Schérer greeted Prince' (the act is at the
mixed reception — not guessed), but 'Prince Andrew Bolkónski arms Anna' where
th

tasks.subject: place: one affordance owns consent (user review) — the checkbox is the gate, the detect button exists only while it is on, and force never bypasses it
tasks.body:
- the old bug: Detect-from-IP called with force:true skipped the ipLookup===false consent guard, so the
  button and the checkbox disagreed about who decides; and first-enable already detected, making the
  button a duplicate act
- mayLookupIp (fold-chat-locale.js): consent-off / already-have-place / first-detect / re-detect — one
  named rule; detectLocaleFromIp routes through it; the panel renders the detect action only under
  consent, Edit place stays as the manual override; the note line speaks the consent state
- falsified: force NEVER bypasses consent; passive calls never re-hit the IP

tasks.subject: reason: the abstraction lattice for the model turn — L1 GROUND (read sentences, quoted) -> L2 LENS (the ask's own words) -> L3 PARADIGM (the declared reply shape), climbed with nested reasoning before speaking; every factual sentence must restate an L1 quote; the scaffold never invents a word (falsified). Also round-two falsify: the pronoun-us expansion bug fixed (determiner/noun licensing, byte-preserving spans), read-cap proven upstream (G1), garbage/homoglyph/regex-fetch controls held

chat: the compound behaves exactly like the proof — all-handoff compounds leave the usual path (the wire's contract, transitive through dependents), a partial compound draws its missing part as a fold notice under the answer; live-verified: research triggers, model audited to zero
